speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Secondary Hypertension due to Unilateral Renal Artery Stenosis (Fibromuscular Dysplasia). The presence of systemic hypertension in a 5-year-old with no family history and negative renal ultrasound for masses strongly suggests renovascular pathology, specifically fibromuscular dysplasia causing unilateral renal artery stenosis, which the abdominal ultrasound may have missed or been too limited to visualize without Doppler flow assessment.
